subject.title: feat(googlechat): support Application Default Credentials for outbound auth

question: Should Google Chat's opt-in `serviceAccountAdc` be allowed to use google-auth-library/gcp-metadata metadata-server requests outside OpenClaw's guarded Google Chat auth transport, or must this PR add an OpenClaw-owned guard before merge?
rationale: The dependency's Compute ADC path reaches cloud metadata hosts directly, while current Google Chat auth hardening guards only the injected GoogleAuth transporter; deciding whether that is acceptable is a security-boundary policy choice.

options.title: Require a metadata guard
options.body: Ask for code and tests that route or constrain Compute metadata ADC access before the new Google Chat config key can merge.

options.title: Accept opt-in metadata ADC
options.body: Record maintainer/security approval that `serviceAccountAdc: true` intentionally permits the standard GCP metadata ADC path for Google Chat outbound auth.

options.title: Pause Google Chat ADC
options.body: Defer or close the feature if keyless Google Chat is not worth expanding this auth boundary now.

recommendation.title: Require a metadata guard
recommendation.body: Ask for code and tests that route or constrain Compute metadata ADC access before the new Google Chat config key can merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest feature-history route for the Google Chat guarded auth transport that the new ADC path bypasses.
